member.name: F:Fluxer.Net.Gateway.Packets.FluxerOpCode.Heartbeat
member.summary: Heartbeat packet to maintain connection. Bidirectional. Client sends periodically, server may request immediate heartbeat.
member.remarks: Clients must send heartbeat packets at the interval specified in the HELLO event. The server responds with . Failure to heartbeat will result in disconnection.

member.name: F:Fluxer.Net.Gateway.Packets.FluxerOpCode.Identify
member.summary: Identifies a new session and authenticates the client. Client → Server. Sent immediately after connection to authenticate.
member.remarks: Contains authentication token, client properties, presence, and event filters. Must be sent before any other client packets (except RESUME). See for payload structure.

member.name: F:Fluxer.Net.Gateway.Packets.FluxerOpCode.PresenceUpdate
member.summary: Updates the client's presence (online status, activity). Client → Server. Changes the user's visible status.
member.remarks: Used to change online status (Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb, Invisible). See for payload structure.

member.name: F:Fluxer.Net.Gateway.Packets.FluxerOpCode.VoiceStateUpdate

member.name: F:Fluxer.Net.Gateway.Packets.FluxerOpCode.VoiceServerPing

member.name: F:Fluxer.Net.Gateway.Packets.FluxerOpCode.Resume
member.summary: Resumes a previous session after disconnection. Client → Server. Attempts to replay missed events from last sequence.
member.remarks: Sent instead of IDENTIFY when reconnecting with a valid session ID. Contains session ID, sequence number, and token. Server responds with RESUMED event if successful, or INVALID_SESSION if failed. See for payload structure.

member.name: F:Fluxer.Net.Gateway.Packets.FluxerOpCode.Reconnect
member.summary: Server requests the client to reconnect. Server → Client. Client should immediately reconnect and attempt RESUME.
member.remarks: Server is requesting a controlled reconnection (e.g., for load balancing). Client should disconnect and reconnect, attempting to RESUME the session.

member.name: F:Fluxer.Net.Gateway.Packets.FluxerOpCode.InvalidSession
